newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Germany's Victoria invests in Irish Dolmen.
newsitem.headline: Germany's Victoria invests in Irish Dolmen.

text.p: German insurance group Victoria has acquired a significant stake in Irish financial services company Dolmen Securies Ltd, Dolmen said in a statement on Thursday.
"The investment brings together the skill, attributes and capital of a well established international financial institution and an emerging Irish securities operation," Dolmen said.

Dolmen, an investment advisory business established in 1994 and admitted to the London Stock Exchange in 1996, said the move was an 'excellent opportunity' for the company to establish itself as an international player.
Victoria, one of the largest German insurance groups, has premium income in excess of 9.0 billion marks and assets in excess of 40 billion marks, the statement said.
